$comment: Code->contract ratchet for the CONNECT hello-ok frame. `undeclared-describe-reads.json` closes this direction for the session describe; nothing closed it for the handshake, which is how a dependency on `auth.deviceToken` entered the bridge unremarked. The reference is 2026.7.2-beta.5's HelloOkSchema — the ONLY vendored connect contract, because the drift-pinned 2026.7.1 vendors no frames.ts at all. MEASURED 2026-08-15, that omission is OURS and not the gateway's: the published openclaw-2026.7.1 image's own HelloOkSchema (app/dist/schema-*.js) declares auth.deviceToken, deviceTokens, scopes and issuedAtMs, so the handshake really does carry them at the pinned version. Vendoring frames.ts for 2026.7.1 is the open follow-up. That gap is the point: a read the newest vendored contract does not declare is a guess, and a read it declares as OPTIONAL must have a stated behaviour when absent. Listing a field here is a REVIEW EVENT, not a silencer.
